“Join us in building Careers and shaping Experiences Beyond the Box” 

About Us

At Atlantic Packaging, every box tells a story and yours begins here. As a proudly Canadian-owned company with over 80 years of excellence in the corrugated packaging industry with operations within North America (Ontario, Quebec and United States), we’re committed to sustainability, customer excellence and community impact. Since 1945, we’ve supported local jobs and built a legacy of trust with our clients and team members. At Atlantic, your ideas matter, your growth is supported and your work makes a real impact.

The Opportunity

We are currently looking to hire a Co-op Power BI Developer (4 months) reporting to the Sr Director, Technical Services. The Co-op Power BI Developer is an integral team member of Atlantic’s Technical Services and will provide support to the Data Analytics team. The successful applicant will be responsible for the development and administration of BI tools and transforming raw data into valuable and meaning insights in the form of appealing dashboards and reports. Location: Atlantic Packaging Head Office, Scarborough - Ontario (Hybrid).

What You’ll Do

Under the supervision of Senior BI Developers, you will:



- Study, analyze, and understand business requirements in the context of business intelligence. 
- Convert business requirements into technical specifications and determine task timelines. 
- Design and map data models to transform raw data into meaningful insights. 
- Design, develop, and deploy Power BI solutions and perform detailed data analysis. 
- Utilize Power BI to create interactive and visually appealing dashboards and reports. 
- Create charts and document data, including algorithms, parameters, models, and relationship explanations. 
- Identify KPIs with clear objectives and monitor performance consistently. 
- Analyze historical and current data through reports to support decision-making. 
- Build multi-dimensional data models. 
- Develop comprehensive documentation for algorithms, parameters, and data models. 
- Perform detailed analysis of tested and deployed Power BI solutions. 
- Write and execute DAX queries and functions in Power BI. 
- Perform SQL queries to extract and analyze data effectively. 
- Define and design new systems by analyzing existing ETL processes. 
- Identify reporting requirements and develop custom charts and visualizations accordingly. 

What You Bring



- Study, analyze, and understand business requirements in the context of business intelligence. 
- Convert business requirements into technical specifications and determine task timelines. 
- Design and map data models to transform raw data into meaningful insights. 
- Design, develop, and deploy Power BI solutions and perform detailed data analysis. 
- Utilize Power BI to create interactive and visually appealing dashboards and reports. 
- Create charts and document data, including algorithms, parameters, models, and relationship explanations. 
- Identify KPIs with clear objectives and monitor performance consistently. 
- Analyze historical and current data through reports to support decision-making. 
- Build multi-dimensional data models. 
- Develop comprehensive documentation for algorithms, parameters, and data models. 
- Perform detailed analysis of tested and deployed Power BI solutions. 
- Write and execute DAX queries and functions in Power BI. 
- Perform SQL queries to extract and analyze data effectively. 
- Define and design new systems by analyzing existing ETL processes. 
- Identify reporting requirements and develop custom charts and visualizations accordingly. 

What We Offer



- Teamwork-focused culture with sustainability initiatives and social events. 
- Opportunities for returning internships and future career growth within the organization. 
- Mentorship and coaching from experienced professionals to support your development. 
- Hands-on experience working on real-world projects and business challenges. 
- Exposure industry-leading tools, technologies and cross-functional teams. 
- A culture of appreciation through a point-based recognition. 
- Employee Assistance Program (EAP). 

Inclusion and Accessibility

Atlantic Packaging is committed to fostering an inclusive, accessible and respectful environment for all candidates. If you require accommodation during the hiring process, please contact our Talent Acquisition team—we’re here to support you.

We sincerely thank all applicants for their interest in joining Atlantic Packaging. While we appreciate the time and effort invested, only those selected for an interview will be contacted.

Please Note

Candidates who are 18 years or older are required to complete a criminal and background check. Details will be provided through the application process.
fit_why: Power BI/DAX focus; BI-specific tooling, though SQL and dashboards overlap

role: Quality and Infrastructure, Co-op Web Developer
jd:
Survalent is looking for innovative and enthusiastic COOP Quality and Infrastructure Developer to join our Web Application Development team for a four-month Winter work term starting in January 2027. In this role, you will contribute to building secure, high-performance, and scalable web applications that help electric utilities monitor, control, and manage power flow to ensure the safe and efficient delivery of electricity. If you are passionate about quality practices and real-time software applications, this is a great opportunity for you!


Responsibilities & Essential Functions:
• Work with the Team Lead/Senior developers to create automated/functional test scripts for both Server / Web Applications.
• Use React, TypeScript, .NET Core, SQL, and other modern technologies to design scalable architectures, build responsive user interfaces, and develop robust APIs
• Coordinate with the Build team to integrate those scripts into software building process and advance our CI/CD infrastructure.
• Create technical documentation as required.
• Contribute as a member of a development team to write high-quality and maintainable code including Front-end UI and effective Web (REST) APIs.
• Test real-time software to ensure responsiveness, scalability, and efficiency.
• Follow Agile development processes to ensure efficiency while maintaining product robustness and quality.
• Other duties as required


Education, Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:
• Currently enrolled in a university program in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.
• Experience and/or familiarity of TypeScript.
• Experience or familiarity with front-end web development (e.g. HTML5, JavaScript).
• Experience working with any web/JavaScript framework (e.g. React, Angular, or Vue).
• Solid understanding of object-oriented programming principles and software design patterns.
• An ability to learn and develop solutions across platforms and understand new technologies.
• Any Database skills (MS SQL/MySQL, MongoDb).
• Experience using Visual Studio and developer frameworks.
• Experience designing and developing software using design patterns and objected oriented concepts.
• Experience with any source control applications including Git, Bitbucket.
• Experience with CURL, Postman, Swagger, Fiddler and similar technologies.
• Experience of multi-threading and other performance-related design constructs.
• Any experience with building intuitive, mobile-friendly and responsive UI/UX design.


This position will report to the Team Lead of Web Applications. We have a casual friendly and highly collaborate environment. If you are interested in this exciting role, please apply with a resume and cover letter. by selecting the following link: https://www.fitzii.com/apply/100918?s=li


About Us:
Survalent Technology Corporation is the leading provider of real-time smart grid management systems for enabling visualization, optimization and improved operations for utilities. For six decades, we have helped more than 800 utilities use operational data to increase reliability, efficiency, and customer service. With our proven and reliable SCADA (Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition), Distribution Management System (DMS), Outage Management System (OMS), and Substation Automation (SA) solutions, utilities transform data into actionable intelligence. We partner with utilities across the globe to create mission critical solutions that will achieve the promise of the Smart Grid.


Survalent values a diverse workplace and strongly encourages women, people of all races, color, creed, ancestry, ethnic origin, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, religion, national origin, citizenship status, disability, marital status, family status, and those with disabilities to apply. We use AI tools to help streamline parts of our recruitment process, but every application is reviewed by a member of our team. Survalent is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to providing accommodations for persons with disabilities. If you require accommodation, we will work with you to meet your needs.


While we appreciate the interest of all applicants, only those selected for an interview will be contacted.
fit_why: React/TypeScript and REST API work fit; .NET Core and QA tooling are gaps

Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit www.shield.ai. Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and YouTube. 
 
Our Summer Internship program is a wonderful opportunity for Fall and Spring graduates to immerse themselves in an innovative and mission driven culture. Our paid internship program will provide you with hands on mentorship, an opportunity to add real contribution to our company via your internship project, and a possible job offer at the end. You will have the chance to make lifelong friendships, expand your network, and learn all about what it's like to work in a high-growth, fast scaling tech unicorn. You'll take part in company sponsored events and enjoy exploring a new city. Read on below to learn more about this unique internship!


 
 


About the Role:
Shield AI's Software Development Engineer Intern program spans engineers who design, build, and test the code that powers our autonomous systems — from user-facing applications and embedded flight software to machine learning models and the underlying systems platforms that tie it all together. Over 10–12 weeks, interns work alongside full-time engineers to analyze requirements, write and debug production-quality code, and ship a real feature or capability using our standard Agile development practices.

 Example Intern Projects 

• 
 Applications: Build a new feature or internal tool (web, mobile, or desktop) that streamlines a mission-planning or fleet-management workflow.

• 
 Firmware/Embedded: Develop and debug embedded C/C++ code for a flight controller or sensor module, including bring-up and hardware-in-the-loop testing.

• 
 Machine Learning: Train, evaluate, and integrate a perception or decision-making model (e.g., object detection, sensor fusion) into an autonomy pipeline.

• 
 Systems Development: Extend a platform tool, API, or data pipeline that supports autonomy software, simulation, or cloud infrastructure.

Required Qualifications:
• 
 Currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field

• 
 Proficiency in at least one modern programming language (e.g., C, C++, Python, Java, or JavaScript)

• 
 Solid foundation in data structures, algorithms, and software design principles

• 
 Experience writing, testing, and debugging code, whether through coursework, personal projects, or prior internships

• 
 Familiarity with version control (e.g., Git) and collaborative development workflows

• 
 Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to break down ambiguous requirements into working code

• 
 Effective written and verbal communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively in a team environment

Preferred Qualifications:
• 
 Exposure to mobile or web application frameworks and full-stack development

• 
 Hands-on experience with embedded systems, microcontrollers, real-time operating systems, or assembly-level debugging

• 
 Coursework or projects involving machine learning, statistics, probability theory, or deep learning frameworks (e.g., PyTorch, TensorFlow)

• 
 Experience with cloud platforms, databases, networking, or distributed systems

• 
 Familiarity with Agile/Scrum development methodologies

• 
 Prior internship, research, or club/competition experience in robotics, autonomy, or aerospace applications

• 
 Interest in or exposure to the defense, aerospace, or autonomous systems industry
